from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageFilter
import cv2
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter
import artifact_io

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
W,H=256,144
src=np.array(Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
Y,X=np.mgrid[:H,:W].astype(np.float32)

# Recover the small portions of the wall concealed by the two released objects.
ball_remove=((X-83.7)/14.1)**2+((Y-33.5)/14.7)**2<1
block_remove=(X>=209)&(X<=223)&(Y>=32)&(Y<=64)
mask=(ball_remove|block_remove).astype(np.uint8)*255
clean=cv2.inpaint(src,mask,5,cv2.INPAINT_TELEA)
# Smooth the reconstructed wall, with the surrounding photographic texture intact.
for region in (ball_remove,block_remove):
    smooth=cv2.GaussianBlur(clean,(7,7),1.1)
    clean[region]=smooth[region]

# Use the observed colors, seam and fuzz of the original ball, not a replacement.
def ball_sprite():
    x0,y0,x1,y1=68,17,101,50
    p=src[y0:y1,x0:x1].astype(float)
    b=clean[y0:y1,x0:x1].astype(float)
    yy,xx=np.mgrid[y0:y1,x0:x1]
    rr=np.sqrt(((xx-83.6)/12.1)**2+((yy-32.6)/12.25)**2)
    # Outer defocused silhouette; estimate coverage against the recovered wall.
    a=np.clip((b.mean(2)-p.mean(2))/np.maximum(b.mean(2)-30,1),0,1)
    a[rr<.86]=1
    a*=np.clip((1.19-rr)/.13,0,1)
    a[(yy<21)&(rr>.93)]=0
    fg=(p-b*(1-a[...,None]))/np.maximum(a[...,None],.015)
    fg=np.clip(fg,0,255)
    return fg.astype(np.float32),a.astype(np.float32),(83.6-x0,32.6-y0)

def block_sprite():
    x0,y0,x1,y1=208,31,225,66
    p=src[y0:y1,x0:x1].astype(float)
    b=clean[y0:y1,x0:x1].astype(float)
    chroma=p[:,:,0]-p[:,:,1]
    bc=b[:,:,0]-b[:,:,1]
    a=np.clip((chroma-bc)/104,0,1)
    yy,xx=np.mgrid[y0:y1,x0:x1]
    a[((xx>=213)&(xx<=218)&(yy>=39)&(yy<=56))]=1
    a*=np.clip((xx-210)/2,0,1)*np.clip((222-xx)/2,0,1)
    fg=(p-b*(1-a[...,None]))/np.maximum(a[...,None],.01)
    fg=np.clip(fg,0,255)
    return fg.astype(np.float32),a.astype(np.float32),(216-x0,47.8-y0)

# Ballistic flight and soft, strongly damped rebounds from a pillow.
g=400.
ball_y0=32.6; ball_rest=104.3; ball_delay=.04
hit_b=ball_delay+np.sqrt(2*(ball_rest-ball_y0)/g)
vb=np.sqrt(2*g*(ball_rest-ball_y0))
block_y0=47.8; block_delay=.02; block_hit=block_delay+np.sqrt(2*(98.8-block_y0)/g)

def ball_state(t):
    if t<hit_b:
        q=max(t-ball_delay,0)
        return 83.6+.7*q,ball_y0+.5*g*q*q,.0+q*13,0.,1.,1.
    s=t-hit_b

    if s<.095:

        return 84.0,ball_rest+press,8+s*45,press,1+.035*press,1-.032*press
    s-=.095

    if s<dur:
        height=bounce_v*s-.5*g*s*s
        return 84+.7*s/dur,ball_rest-height,13+18*s/dur,0,1,1
    s-=dur
    bounce_v=17.; dur2=2*bounce_v/g
    if s<dur2:
        height=bounce_v*s-.5*g*s*s
        return 84.7,ball_rest-height,31,0,1,1
    s-=dur2
    x=84.7+1.6*(1-np.exp(-s*3.8))
    y=ball_rest+.55*(1-np.exp(-s*4.))
    return x,y,31+(x-84.7)*4.,0,1,1

def block_state(t):
    if t<block_hit:
        q=max(0,t-block_delay)
        return 216+.9*q,block_y0+.5*g*q*q,-q*14,0,1,1
    s=t-block_hit
    # A narrow rectangular block tips onto its side, rather than bouncing like the ball.
    u=np.clip(s/.31,0,1)
    theta=-8-80*(u*u*(3-2*u))
    halfheight=11.3*abs(np.cos(np.deg2rad(theta)))+4*abs(np.sin(np.deg2rad(theta)))
    center_y=111.0-halfheight+1.6*np.exp(-s*8)*np.sin(s*17)
    center_x=216.5+2.2*(1-np.exp(-s*5))
    return center_x,center_y,theta,1.5*np.exp(-s*7),1,1

def composite(im,sprite,cx,cy,angle,sx=1,sy=1,blur=0):
    fg,a,origin=sprite
    ang=np.deg2rad(angle)
    c,s=np.cos(ang),np.sin(ang)
    mat=np.array([[c*sx,-s*sy,0],[s*sx,c*sy,0]],np.float32)
    mat[:,2]=[cx,cy]-mat[:,:2]@np.array(origin)
    pa=fg*a[...,None]
    aa=cv2.warpAffine(a,mat,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
    pp=cv2.warpAffine(pa,mat,(W,H),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
    if blur>.04:
        # Short shutter integration at high fall velocity.
        k=int(np.ceil(blur))*2+1
        aa=cv2.GaussianBlur(aa,(1,k),sigmaX=0,sigmaY=blur)
        pp=cv2.GaussianBlur(pp,(1,k),sigmaX=0,sigmaY=blur)
    return im*(1-aa[...,None])+pp

def shadow(im,cx,cy,rx,ry,strength):
    a=np.exp(-.5*(((X-cx)/rx)**2+((Y-cy)/ry)**2))*strength
    return im*(1-a[...,None])

def pillow_deform(im,bx,compression_b,compression_o,t):
    # Local material deflection only; camera and all other scene geometry are locked.
    elapsed=max(0,t-hit_b)
    depth_b=(.7*(1-np.exp(-elapsed*4)) if t>hit_b else 0)+compression_b
    depth_o=(.45 if t>block_hit else 0)+compression_o*.6
    dy=depth_b*np.exp(-.5*(((X-bx)/16)**2+((Y-115)/6)**2))
    dy+=depth_o*np.exp(-.5*(((X-219)/18)**2+((Y-111)/5)**2))
    # No warp outside the pillow surfaces.
    dy*=np.clip((Y-103)/5,0,1)
    return cv2.remap(im.astype(np.float32),X,(Y-dy).astype(np.float32),cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_REFLECT)

frames=[src.copy()]
for i in range(1,20):
    t=i/4
    bx,by,ba,bc,bsx,bsy=ball_state(t)
    ox,oy,oa,oc,osx,osy=block_state(t)
    im=pillow_deform(clean,bx,bc,oc,t)
    # Diffuse cast shadows approach the landing points and tighten at contact.
    bh=max(0,ball_rest-by)
    oh=max(0,111-oy-(11.3*abs(np.cos(np.deg2rad(oa)))+4*abs(np.sin(np.deg2rad(oa)))))
    im=shadow(im,bx+1,116.2+bc*.15,11+bh*.055,2.3+bh*.015,.27*np.exp(-bh/24))
    im=shadow(im,ox+.3,111.6,11 if t>block_hit else 5+oh*.08,2.1+oh*.02,.24*np.exp(-oh/24))
    if t<hit_b:
        im=shadow(im,bx+8,by+6,12,13,.055)
    if t<block_hit:
        im=shadow(im,ox+5,oy+3,5,12,.025)
    blur_b=0 if t>=hit_b else min(1.2,g*max(0,t-ball_delay)*.004)
    blur_o=0 if t>=block_hit else min(1.5,g*max(0,t-block_delay)*.005)
    im=composite(im,ball,bx,by,ba,bsx,bsy,blur_b)
    im=composite(im,block,ox,oy,oa,osx,osy,blur_o)
    frames.append(np.clip(im,0,255).round().astype(np.uint8))
artifact_io.save(np.stack(frames),ROOT)

from pathlib import Path
import base64
import json
import wave

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw


def save(frames, case_dir, audio=None):
    case_dir = Path(case_dir)
    frames = np.asarray(frames)
    path = case_dir / "task_spec.json"
    spec = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    n, h, w, fps = (spec.get("frames", 20), spec.get("height", 144), spec.get("width", 256), spec.get("fps", 4))
    assert frames.shape == (n, h, w, 3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8, frames.shape
    audio_spec = spec.get("audio")
    audio_url = None
    if audio_spec:
        samples = round(n / fps * audio_spec["sample_rate"])
        pcm = np.asarray(audio)
        if pcm.ndim == 1:
            pcm = pcm[:, None]
        assert pcm.shape == (samples, audio_spec["channels"]) and pcm.dtype == np.int16, (pcm.shape, pcm.dtype)
        with wave.open(str(case_dir / "audio.wav"), "wb") as handle:
            handle.setnchannels(audio_spec["channels"])
            handle.setsampwidth(2)
            handle.setframerate(audio_spec["sample_rate"])
            handle.writeframes(pcm.astype("<i2").tobytes())
        audio_url = "data:audio/wav;base64," + base64.b64encode((case_dir / "audio.wav").read_bytes()).decode()
    values = frames.astype(np.uint32)
    packed = (values[:, :, :, 0] << 16) | (values[:, :, :, 1] << 8) | values[:, :, :, 2]
    tensor = packed.transpose(1, 2, 0)
    np.savez_compressed(case_dir / "pixels.npz", pixels=tensor)

    folder = case_dir / "frames"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(folder / f"{index:02d}.png")

    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, (h + 21) * 2), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(np.linspace(0, n - 1, 8).round().astype(int)):
        x, y = (index % 4) * w, (index // 4) * (h + 21)
        draw.text((x + 5, y + 3), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, y + 21))
    sheet.save(case_dir / "inspection.png")

    transition = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, h * 2 + 21), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(transition)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(min(i, n-1) for i in range(4)):
        x = index * w
        draw.text((x + 5, 4), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, 21))
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]).resize((w, h), Image.Resampling.NEAREST), (x, h + 21))
    transition.save(case_dir / "transition_check.png")

    encode = lambda array: base64.b64encode(np.asarray(array, dtype="<u4").tobytes()).decode()
    deltas = []
    for index in range(1, n):
        current = packed[index].reshape(-1)
        previous = packed[index - 1].reshape(-1)
        positions = np.flatnonzero(current != previous)
        packet = []
        if len(positions):
            bounds = np.r_[0, np.flatnonzero(np.diff(positions) > 1) + 1, len(positions)]
            for start, end in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
